response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering credentials with 15+ years of experience and proven performance optimization skills, this role requires specialized expertise in SoC modeling, IP design, and GPU architecture optimization that is entirely absent from his resume. His background is fundamentally software-focused (backend, full-stack, web systems), whereas this Principal Performance Architect position demands deep hardware design knowledge and AI accelerator expertise outside his technical domain.
strengths: Extensive systems engineering and performance optimization background from working on low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems handling millions of requests per second
Principal/Staff level technical seniority with proven architectural design skills and demonstrated ability to mentor others across multiple domains
Technical adaptability as a polyglot engineer comfortable across multiple programming languages and full-stack development, suggesting learning agility
concerns: Complete absence of SoC and IP modeling experience, which is a core required skill and typically requires specialized hardware design training
No demonstrated GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD systems, or hardware accelerator experience—critical for AI accelerator optimization work
Limited deep learning and neural network optimization background; current AI work appears to be infrastructure and tooling-focused rather than hardware-level optimization

key_factors.factor: SoC/IP modeling and hardware design expertise gap
GPU architecture and AI accelerator experience gap
General systems engineering and performance optimization background
